title: AlphaBoard
tagline: A DeFi trading system that merges advanced analytics, copy trading, and instant execution
description:
AlphaBoard is a DeFi trading system that merges advanced analytics, copy trading, and instant execution into a single experience.

Built for active traders and on-chain strategists, AlphaBoard provides:

Real-time portfolio and PnL analytics across multiple chains
Whale trade tracking with contextual insights
Instant, gasless transfers and executions via state channels
Copy trading infrastructure for following top-performing wallets
Data-driven decision making with live market intelligence
how_its_made:
Core Stack
1. Blockscout MCP
Open blockchain data source

Token balances, transactions, and NFT ownership
Real-time wallet and contract metadata
Multi-chain coverage (Ethereum, Base, Polygon)
Resilient fallback via Zerion API
Transparent data headers (X-Data-Source) for traceability
Purpose: Data visibility and analytics foundation.

2. Envio HyperSync
Event indexing and analytics engine

High-performance event streaming (100x faster than RPC)
Tracks wallet activity, token flows, and whale behavior
Real-time trade monitoring for major tokens
Historical time-series data for PnL and frequency analysis
Custom whale detection with configurable thresholds
Purpose: Trading intelligence and behavioral analytics.

3. Yellow Network
Execution layer for gasless, instant trades

State channel architecture via @erc7824/nitrolite
Session key pattern for authenticated instant transfers
Sub-second finality with zero gas
Integrated with portfolio positions for one-click execution
Fallback to standard transfers for unsupported assets
Purpose: Instant settlement and copy trade execution.
